title: 地下水抽出處理
summary: 本課以「結合含水層捕獲、地上處理與污染反彈評估抽出處理」為主軸，依序處理地層、水頭與污染羽流、抽水井捕獲尺度、水量與污染負荷配對、孔隙體積與清理拖尾、停泵反彈與捕獲復核。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
summaryEn: This course focuses on Evaluate pump-and-treat through aquifer capture, above-ground treatment and rebound, progressing through Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume, Extraction-well capture scale, Pairing water flow with contaminant load, Pore volumes and cleanup tailing, Shutdown rebound and capture review. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

stages.title: 系統邊界與現場觀察

stages.descriptionEn: Build evidence through mechanisms, worked examples, actions and diagnosis.

steps.title: 地層、水頭與污染羽流：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 地層、水頭與污染羽流 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 以同一高程基準連結觀測井，先定地下水流向，再區分溶解污染與持續污染源。 水頭差除以距離給指定方向的梯度；單一剖面不能代替三維地下水流場。
steps.instructionEn: Connect monitoring wells to one elevation datum, determine flow direction and distinguish dissolved contamination from continuing sources. Head difference over spacing gives a directional gradient; one section cannot replace a three-dimensional groundwater field.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：兩點水頭 h1=12.4 m、h2=11.8 m；距離 L=30 m。公式 i=(h1-h2)/L，計算得 0.02 m/m。適用邊界：同一標高基準、同一含水層及同步讀值。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: Heads h1=12.4 m, h2=11.8 m; spacing L=30 m. Formula i=(h1-h2)/L gives 0.02 m/m. Applicability: Common elevation datum, same aquifer and synchronized readings.
steps.failure: 不同濾管深度或時間的液位可能產生假的水平梯度。 在「地層、水頭與污染羽流」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Different screen depths or measurement times can create a false horizontal gradient. Mark where this error can enter the Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「地層、水頭與污染羽流」，測井口標高並校正液位，將多井等水頭線與地層圖共同判讀。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
steps.checkEn: For Stratigraphy, heads and contaminant plume, Survey reference elevations, correct water levels and interpret multiwell contours with stratigraphy. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

knowledge.title: 地層、水頭與污染羽流

knowledge.title: 驗證與操作練習
knowledge.text: 只將 h1 改成 12.7 m，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.02 變成 0.03 m/m。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
knowledge.textEn: Change only h1 to 12.7 m, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.02 to 0.03 m/m. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

steps.title: 地下水孔隙流速：機制與觀察
steps.titleEn: Groundwater pore velocity: Mechanism and observation
steps.objective: 辨識 地下水孔隙流速 的機制，說明可觀察的因果關係。
steps.objectiveEn: Identify the mechanism of Groundwater pore velocity and its observable causal relationships.
steps.instruction: 將水力傳導係數、梯度與有效孔隙率逐項測定，避免把地層孔隙率直接等同可移動孔隙率。 孔隙平均流速為 Darcy 通量除有效孔隙率；污染遲滯與彌散另需處理。
steps.instructionEn: Determine conductivity, gradient and effective porosity separately rather than equating total with mobile porosity. Mean pore-water velocity is Darcy flux divided by effective porosity; retardation and dispersion require separate treatment.
steps.observation: 原創教學假設，非現場操作值：K=1e-4 m/s；水力梯度 i=0.01；有效孔隙率 ne=0.25。公式 v=K*i/ne*86400，計算得 0.3456 m/d。適用邊界：飽和均質含水層、層流，非裂隙運移預測。
steps.observationEn: Original teaching assumptions, not field operating values: K=1e-4 m/s; hydraulic gradient i=0.01; effective porosity ne=0.25. Formula v=K*i/ne*86400 gives 0.3456 m/d. Applicability: Saturated homogeneous aquifer and laminar flow; not a fractured-flow prediction.
steps.failure: 把 Darcy 通量直接當孔隙流速會低估移動速度。 在「地下水孔隙流速」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
steps.failureEn: Using Darcy flux directly as pore velocity understates travel speed. Mark where this error can enter the Groundwater pore velocity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
steps.check: 針對「地下水孔隙流速」，將估算流速與示蹤到達、地層和水頭場比較，列出各參數範圍。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
